plugins.name: web-modernize
plugins.description: Guides teams through migrating legacy web applications to modern stacks. Provides /web-modernize:analyze, plan, scaffold (legacy-asset copy + toolchain preflight), next, verify (behavioural-parity + security gate), parity-check, quality-check (advisory idiomatic-code review), rollback, retry, sync, report, and other slash commands. Per-unit state file split for multi-developer concurrency.
